fusions.name: Seam Cut
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Slips a scale-edge between its plates for 18 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Probing Edge
fusions.desc: A quick cut that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Find the Seam
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Wait Edge
fusions.desc: After several hits without a critical hit, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Your armour is 6% higher at all times. Once every 8 seconds.
